basic_info.description: Built in 1960, 455 Warren Drive is a twelve unit apartment building located on the border of the Inner Sunset and Forest Knolls. The building has been owned by the same family for several decades, is professionally managed and well-maintained. The building consists of nine one-bedroom units, three two-bedroom units and 13 parking spaces.  The property has a new roof, seismic retrofit completed, new carpet and paint in the common areas and upgraded western facing unit decks. Many of the units have been remodeled and they all have their own furnace, water heater and individual water meters. With significant rental upside, 455 Warren Drive presents a great opportunity for investors.
